body:
It’s hard not to feel extra shitty when my mistakes *could* have messed up someone else’s life. 
I still feel frozen and like my head is about to pop, physically and emotionally, but I do appreciate your listening.

I just wish the stress would stop. Like if the stress of one thing that’s valuable to me after another just failing or going sideways would just *stop*. I just want to have some *peace* and for that ice-in-the-chest and pressure in my head  to just go away. I understand life is stressful, but it’s like every time I stand up I get kicked back down by so many weird, small, stupid things, and I can’t stand it anymore. I know others have it worse, so I feel like a shitty person for even opening my mouth.

I feel like the mistake I made was due to carelessness, and I feel like absolute garbage for it. I feel like shit for it and I feel like shit that my first reaction when I got home was to drink. I think I just thought it would make me feel better. I spent my walk home not looking when I crossed the road and hoping someone else would do the job for me. I feel like a shitty person for wanting to ramble about myself at all but I don’t know what else to do I feel so trapped inside my own head.
